title: Badge Printer
story: North of the garden, a badge printer keeps producing generic employee names. Ivo asks the engineer to restore their own badge and three coworkers' labels, typing plain keys exactly as printed. Mira, waiting near the Records door, says she will be in the mailroom once the printer is honest.

steps.objective: Ask Ivo about the badge printer.
Print the badge and the labels, one key at a time.
Print the shuffled label without highlights.
Optional: hear Mira's offer in the mailroom.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Print the engineer's badge and three coworkers' labels, then a badge number and a two-name card, one plain mapped key at a time (b w 0 4 u t m x n v r and comma).
success_criteria: Each card's text equals its target exactly (lowercase)
All twelve mapped plain keys b, w, 0, 4, u, t, m, x, n, v, r and comma were typed as plain taps

task.prompt: Badge printer: type each card's text. Preview shows the badge as it prints.

items.prompt: Print the Rao and Bea, one card

task.accepts: resulting text equals target; the printer checks text, not physical key origin
rejects: nav output left in the field (word jump, page, delete, Return)
uppercase letters (Shift is introduced at the Left Desk)

feedback.other: The card shows the target below the field; the observed text is shown above it. Fix the next character and continue. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

task.labels_are_lowercase: until Shift is taught in level 04, every label and name is lowercase

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Type the home-row keys as plain letters: asdf, jkl; and two names that use them.
success_criteria: asdf, jkl;, sadie and falk are each typed exactly
No modifier output (Control, Option, Command, Shift) appears

rejects: a held key that turns into a modifier (a quick tap-and-release is expected)

feedback.other: A held home-row key becomes a modifier. Tap each letter and release. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Print three mixed labels that roll across home-row keys on one hand and mix in digits and a comma; rolls must stay letters.
success_criteria: Same-hand rolls such as sd, jk and kl stay literal letters

task.prompt: Mixed labels: roll the letters, do not hold them.

feedback.other: The card shows the target below the field; the observed text is shown above it. Fix the next character and continue. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Print one shuffled label with every mapped plain key and the home row, with no highlighted keys.

items.target: wren bo, umi tex vn 04 flask dad; jk

feedback.other: The card shows the target below the field; the observed text is shown above it. Fix the next character and continue. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: The badge printer keeps printing generic names. Please restore my badge and three coworkers' labels.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `b` in Bea's name, you need to press B.

hint.action: To print the `b` in Bea's name, you need to press B.
hint.gesture: tap B. It only jumps by word while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `w` in Wren's name, you need to press W.

hint.action: To print the `w` in Wren's name, you need to press W.
hint.gesture: tap W. It only jumps by word while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `r` in Wren's name, you need to press R.

hint.action: To print the `r` in Wren's name, you need to press R.
hint.gesture: tap R. A plain R types r; reload is Control + Shift + R.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `n` in Wren's name, you need to press N.

hint.action: To print the `n` in Wren's name, you need to press N.
hint.gesture: tap N. It only submits (Return) while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `u` in Umi's name, you need to press U.

hint.action: To print the `u` in Umi's name, you need to press U.
hint.gesture: tap U. It only pages up while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `m` in Umi's name, you need to press M.

hint.action: To print the `m` in Umi's name, you need to press M.
hint.gesture: tap M. It only deletes backward while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `t` in Kit's name, you need to press T.

hint.action: To print the `t` in Kit's name, you need to press T.
hint.gesture: tap T. It only jumps to the document start while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `x` in Xan's name, you need to press X.

hint.action: To print the `x` in Xan's name, you need to press X.
hint.gesture: tap X. It only deletes forward (Control + D) while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print the `v` in Tove's name, you need to press V.

hint.action: To print the `v` in Tove's name, you need to press V.
hint.gesture: tap V. V alone still types v; the practice toggle needs the physical modifiers.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To print badge number 40, you need to press 4, then 0.

hint.action: To print badge number 40, you need to press 4, then 0.
hint.gesture: tap 4, tap 0. Plain taps stay digits on base.

dialogue.speaker: printer_card
dialogue.text: To separate the two names, you need to press comma.

hint.action: To separate the two names, you need to press comma.
hint.gesture: tap comma. It only deletes forward while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: To print the `b` in Bea's name, you need to press B.

hint.action: To print the `b` in Bea's name, you need to press B.
hint.gesture: tap B. It only jumps by word while nav is held.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: Every card says what it should. The task light has steadied. Mira is in the mailroom if you want a loop to learn.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Once the printer is honest, find me in the mailroom. I will teach you the loop.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: The old badge names a department that does not match today's sign.
dialogue.cue: Engineer: inspecting a tampering artifact (Unissued badge)

then.text: Morning Mail is available in the mailroom.

state_changes.before: The north task light pulses unsteadily, the printer spits generic names, Mira waits by the Records door, Ivo's tablet is calm.
state_changes.after: The task light is steady, cards print in varied colors, Mira has moved into the southeast mailroom, Ivo's tablet starts flashing for the broken scheduling form.

optional_artifact.name: Unissued badge
caption: An old employee badge that was never handed out.
Its department name differs from the one on the current sign.
Someone changed the name after it was printed.

pace_copy.text: Badge accuracy: every card printed on time.

review_notes: At 1366x768 the printer and its approach cells (13,3) and (14,3) sit near the top of the screen and well right of the keyboard inset. The reception talk at (12,13) is below the camera's centre with the avatar at screen (160,100), so it stays right of x 147. No inset conflict in this level (LEVEL_SHEET.md).
